Tarikh | Episode 1058 | 09 Sept 2025
In this episode of Tarikh -
Valour tale of Rao Maldeo Rathore, a 16th-century King of Marwar (Rajasthan), and his wife, Umade, the "Ruthi Rani."
# Rao Maldeo was a brilliant ruler of Marwar who significantly expanded his kingdom, even fending off Sher Shah Suri.
# His wife, Umade, earned the name "Ruthi Rani" after he mistakenly spent their wedding night with her maid.
# Outraged by the dishonor, Umade refused to live with Maldeo, choosing to maintain her pride.
